chunks: "Give the call to prayer (adhan) behind the one behind whom you recited."

key_terms.أَذِّنْ: give the call to prayer; pronounce the adhan
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind; in the position of following another in prayer
key_terms.قَرَأْتَ: you recited; here referring to performing the prayer recitation

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about giving the adhan behind someone one prayed behind?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal instruction related to congregational prayer and the adhan. It indicates the permissibility or directive of giving the adhan in relation to one behind whom one has prayed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1129 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Give the call to prayer (adhan) behind the one you recited the prayer behind”.
